_source: Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) 2015/35, consolidated text CELEX 02015R0035-20241114, Annex IX (geographical division of regions into risk zones).
_note: peril -> region -> {basis, rule_quote, map[, ambiguous, note]}. map: normalised prefix/code/unit -> zone key exactly as in the zonal file of the same version (numeric keys without leading zeros, letters kept); identity maps are given explicitly. Prefixes printed for more than one zone are NOT in map; they are under ambiguous with every candidate zone. rule_quote is verbatim from the consolidated text with consolidation markers (►Mn/◄) removed. Annex IX is one geography for all perils; the per-peril entries repeat it for the regions zoned for that peril.
part_of_region_rule_quote: The regions Principality of Andorra, Principality of Lichtenstein, Principality of Monaco, Republic of San Marino and Vatican City State shall consist of only one zone each. The zones shall be mapped to the following regions:
single_zone_rule_quote: The regions LU, MT, Guadeloupe, Martinique, St Martin and Reunion shall consist of only one zone.

AT.rule_quote: The mapping of risk zones for the regions AT, CZ, CH, DE, HE, IT, NL, NO, PL, PT, ES and SK shall be based on the first 2 digits of the postal code

BE.rule_quote: The mapping of risk zones for the regions BE and CY shall be based on the first digit of the postal code

CZ.rule_quote: The mapping of risk zones for the regions AT, CZ, CH, DE, HE, IT, NL, NO, PL, PT, ES and SK shall be based on the first 2 digits of the postal code

CH.rule_quote: The mapping of risk zones for the regions AT, CZ, CH, DE, HE, IT, NL, NO, PL, PT, ES and SK shall be based on the first 2 digits of the postal code
CH.note: Rule (1) says first 2 digits of the postal code, but the Annex IX part-2 table lists CH zones as values 1-26, which cannot be 2-digit Swiss postcode prefixes (10-97). The map is the table as printed (value -> zone); the postcode -> value step is not given in Annex IX. Installed as not_postal: the table's codes are not postal-code prefixes, so a risk's zone cannot be read from its postal code; the region is grouped under Art. 90b unless the zone is known.
